pages.text: $(bold)Nyarlathotep's Desire$(): desire is the stairway to the abyss.$(br2)Effect: each level grants 1 additional $(bold)ability slot$(), up to level 5.$(br2)Obtaining: attack a villager, then make it die by non-player hands within 5 seconds (falling / drowning / other creatures); 10 seconds later you have a 50% chance to gain it — otherwise you suffer Wither II for 60 seconds.
